related.title: GPS 民用定位系統
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：教學成功目標 0.99 時三次模型通過、兩次不足；仍須測試相關中斷與截止時間。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: For teaching success 0.99, three attempts pass and two fail, subject to correlated-outage and deadline tests. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 把接收器時鐘偏差換成偽距誤差，說明為何必須共同估計時鐘。
related.differenceEn: Convert receiver clock bias into pseudorange error and explain joint clock estimation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學單次成功率 0.8，最多嘗試 3 次，訊息內容相同且可去重。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：P交付=1−0.2³。 結果約 0.992 fraction。每次成功率 p，最多 n 次至少成功一次的機率=1−(1−p)^n；同一持續中斷期間不獨立。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學光速取 3×10⁸ m/s，接收器時鐘慢或快的符號另定，偏差大小 20 ns。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：|δρ|=3×10⁸×20×10⁻⁹。 結果約 6 m。偽距包含幾何距離加 cδt；所有衛星共用的接收器時鐘偏差不等於每軸位置誤差。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Use teaching single-attempt success 0.8, at most three attempts and a deduplicatable message. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: Pdelivery=1−0.2³. Result ≈ 0.992 fraction. With success p per attempt, success within n attempts is 1−(1−p)^n; attempts during one persistent outage are not independent.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Use teaching c=3×10⁸ m/s and clock-bias magnitude 20 ns, defining sign separately. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: |δρ|=3×10⁸×20×10⁻⁹. Result ≈ 6 m. Pseudorange includes geometric range plus cδt; common receiver-clock bias is not a per-axis position error.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 衛星姿態量測與控制概念
related.titleEn: Satellite attitude sensing and control concepts
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：教學成功目標 0.99 時三次模型通過、兩次不足；仍須測試相關中斷與截止時間。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: For teaching success 0.99, three attempts pass and two fail, subject to correlated-outage and deadline tests. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 由三角速度軌跡估算轉矩需求，區分轉角、角速度與角加速度。
related.differenceEn: Estimate torque for a triangular rate profile, distinguishing angle, rate and angular acceleration.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學單次成功率 0.8，最多嘗試 3 次，訊息內容相同且可去重。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：P交付=1−0.2³。 結果約 0.992 fraction。每次成功率 p，最多 n 次至少成功一次的機率=1−(1−p)^n；同一持續中斷期間不獨立。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學單軸慣量 12 kg m²、轉角 90°=π/2 rad、總時間 60 s。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：τ=12×4×(π/2)/60²。 結果約 0.020944 N m。對稱加減速總角度 θ、總時間 T 時 α=4θ/T²，τ=Iα；忽略耦合、摩擦及柔性模態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Use teaching single-attempt success 0.8, at most three attempts and a deduplicatable message. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: Pdelivery=1−0.2³. Result ≈ 0.992 fraction. With success p per attempt, success within n attempts is 1−(1−p)^n; attempts during one persistent outage are not independent.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Teaching single-axis inertia is 12 kg m², angle 90°=π/2 rad and total time 60 s. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: τ=12×4×(π/2)/60². Result ≈ 0.020944 N m. For symmetric acceleration/deceleration, α=4θ/T² and torque τ=Iα, excluding coupling, friction and flexible modes.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
